notes: All required story categories already covered with no gaps or duplication. No changes made.

BRAND-001-S1.title: Brand Naming Rules Schema and Audit Contract
BRAND-001-S1.description: Define canonical brand rules (e.g., always 'ChatHealthy.ai', never 'ChatHealthy' alone), audit scope (code, frontend, backend, website, docs), and violation schema including file_path, occurrence, severity, and suggested_fix.

BRAND-001-S2.title: Core Brand Audit Scanner
BRAND-001-S2.description: Implement scanning logic to traverse repository artifacts (frontend, backend, website, docs) and detect naming inconsistencies using regex and rule-based matching aligned to the schema.

BRAND-001-S3.title: Brand Audit API and Report Output
BRAND-001-S3.description: Expose audit results via internal API or function and generate structured report (JSON) summarizing violations, counts, and impacted artifacts; include lightweight visualization and CI integration to flag or fail builds on violations.

BRAND-001-S4.title: Automated Fix Suggestions Engine
BRAND-001-S4.description: Generate standardized fix suggestions for each violation (e.g., replace 'ChatHealthy' with 'ChatHealthy.ai') without auto-modifying files, ensuring consistent remediation guidance.
BRAND-001-S4.evidence: GAP: No existing automated brand correction guidance; required to operationalize backlog_brand_audit

BRAND-001-S5.title: Brand Audit Test and Integration Coverage
BRAND-001-S5.description: Create unit and integration tests validating detection accuracy, false positive handling, report generation, and CI enforcement across representative artifacts aligned with UAT scenarios.
